description: Mat-dp core is a Python model for projecting materials needed to build products or low-carbon systems. The JOSS paper describes a linear-programming library that represents resources, processes and constraints. Its own README and pyproject identify the core code, and the licence file states MIT despite GitHub classifying it as NOASSERTION. Spatial coverage and planning period follow the user’s supply-chain scenario, not a built-in regional database. A modeller could estimate steel, aluminium or other material demand from new energy or building infrastructure plans. A caveat is that the projection depends on technology inventories, process yields and supply-chain assumptions. An optimized bill of materials is not proof that suppliers can deliver it or that an environmental effect will occur. No directly related catalogue record was established. The article, README and own licence were read without installing the package or running a scenario.
